summary: This video breaks down all modes and features in the Eve of the Rift anniversary event. Players can claim a free Legendary Hero Prime Chest on day 14 of the Otherworld Tour check-in. The Nightvell Standoff mode requires taking the 12-chapter Fated Path Test to pick a faction and earn Rift Stardust through Temporal Vortex, Dungeons, and Tavern Gambit. Coronation of Night lets players vote for hero skins using Starlight Support Tickets. Starlight Delights offers a Dragon Crystal rebate capped at 30,000, and Starweave Echo allows conversion of duplicate hero imprints into Starweave Echo fragments.

meta_changes: Introduction of Eve of the Rift faction battle system in Nightvell Standoff
Imprint exchange system in Starweave Echo allowing conversion of extra legendary hero imprints
tips: Log in daily for 14 days during Otherworld Tour to claim the free Legendary Hero Prime Chest.
Be sure to select a faction after the Fated Path Test in Nightvell Standoff, as players without a faction cannot acquire Rift Stardust.
Earn Rift Stardust by competing in Temporal Vortex, Dungeons, and Tavern Gambit during the event.
Spend all Starlight Support Tickets before the announcement period ends, as unused tickets will be cleared.
Use Starweave Echo to convert up to 50 duplicate legendary hero imprints into 12 Starweave Echo fragments per imprint.
